description: This module lets you create a PagerDuty change event each time the module is run.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: The environment name, typically production, staging, and so on.

parameters.name: integration_key
parameters.description: The integration key that identifies the service the change was made to. This can be found by adding an integration to a service in PagerDuty.

parameters.name: link_text
parameters.description: Descriptive text for a URL where more information about the deployment can be obtained.

parameters.name: link_url
parameters.description: A URL where more information about the deployment can be obtained.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: The URL of the project repository.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: An identifier of the revision being deployed, typically a number or SHA from a version control system.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source of the change event. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: A short description of the change that occurred.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to submit the change event to. Default: "https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/change/enqueue"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The name of the user or process that triggered this deployment.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates for the target URL are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Track the deployment as a PagerDuty change event
  community.general.pagerduty_change:
    integration_key: abc123abc123abc123abc123abc123ab
    summary: The application was deployed

- name: Track the deployment as a PagerDuty change event with more details
  community.general.pagerduty_change:
    integration_key: abc123abc123abc123abc123abc123ab
    summary: The application was deployed
    source: Ansible Deploy
    user: ansible
    repo: github.com/ansible/ansible
    revision: '4.2'
    environment: production
    link_url: https://github.com/ansible-collections/community.general/pull/1269
    link_text: View changes on GitHub
